Aurora Observatory

The Aurora Observatory opens on Saturday. Admission costs twelve dollars. The telescope tour begins at nine in the evening.

Visitors can explore the exhibition, speak with astronomers, and learn how the telescope records the night sky. The exhibition explains the history of the observatory and the research carried out by its staff.
